title: Sable Retail POC — Security Q&A and Evidence Catalog
body:
Purpose:
This is the working security and compliance catalogue for the Sable Retail POC (payment fraud detection pipeline). Purpose is twofold: 1) provide Sable’s Infosec team a compact Q&A with artifact references they can validate, and 2) track outstanding evidence tasks that the solutions engineering + security SMEs will need to close before customer security sign-off.

POC summary (brief):
- Customer: Sable Retail (retail payments / fraud analytics).
- Scope: Redwood Dedicated deployment in us-west-2; model serving for transaction scoring, realtime low-latency inference, with redaction pipeline for PII.
- Duration: 8 weeks (pilot), production decision gated on security & compliance acceptance.

Workshop notes (2025-09-18, Security deep-dive w/ Sable Infosec):
- Attendees: Amelia, Devon, Marisol, Ravi (Redwood); Sarah Liu (Sable InfoSec), Omar Farouk (Sable Platform), Evan Ross (Sable Legal).
- Key asks from Sable: KMS key control, audit trail retention >= 1 year, SLA for incident response, proof of network isolation (VPC peering & flow logs), and evidence of HSM-backed signing for model artifacts.
- Action items assigned during workshop: see Evidence index below (column: owner, due).
- Notes: Sable wants limited human access to logs containing token-level output; asked about ability to configure redaction and sampling. We demonstrated prefix KV caching with PII mask; they requested a reproducible demo.

Top-level answers (for questionnaire):
1) Data residency & isolation: Dedicated deployment in customer VPC, private control plane option shown. Evidence: VPC peering diagram (artifact A1), Dedicated deployment runbook (A2).
2) Key management: We support customer-managed KMS + optional HSM integration. Evidence: KMS integration design doc (A3), HSM stub log sample (A4).
3) Audit logs & retention: System produces immutable audit events; retention configurable. Evidence: logging config example (A5), sample syslog export for a 30-day window (A6).
4) Access controls: RBAC with SSO, lattice of roles; support for just-in-time access via Okta integration. Evidence: RBAC matrix (A7), Okta SSO setup steps (A8).
5) Vulnerability management: Regular vulnerability scans + patch cadence documented. Evidence: monthly scan reports (A9), CVE response process (A10).

Evidence index (working):
- A1: VPC peering diagram + CIDR mapping (owner: Ravi, due: 2025-09-26) — can be exported from network team Confluence page. Link: Confluence/SablePOC/VPC-diagram.
- A2: Dedicated deployment runbook (owner: Marisol, due: 2025-09-30) — includes terraform plan snippets and capacity reservations for pilot GPUs.
- A3: KMS integration design (owner: Amelia, due: 2025-09-22) — includes sample IAM policies for CMK use and rotation schedule.
- A4: HSM stub signing log (owner: Devon, due: 2025-10-05) — redacted example of model artifact signing performed in lab HSM.
- A5: Logging config example (owner: Jordan, due: 2025-09-20) — shows ELK stack ingestion, log schema fields and redaction markers.
- A6: Sample syslog export (owner: Jordan, due: 2025-09-24) — sample for 30-day retention, redacted.
- A7: RBAC matrix (owner: Priya, due: 2025-09-18 — draft available) — includes role definitions: admin, infra-operator, model-ops, observer.
- A8: Okta SSO setup steps (owner: Priya, due: 2025-09-22) — includes test-user checklist used in the workshop.
- A9: Monthly vuln scan report (owner: DevSecOps team, due: 2025-10-01) — aggregated scanner output, triage status.
- A10: CVE response process (owner: Ravi, due: 2025-09-28) — high-level runbook + notification tree.
- A11: Sample KV-cache policy and prefix cache retention doc (owner: Marisol, due: 2025-09-26) — shows how PII prefix keys are masked and eviction policy.
- A12: Token-level telemetry redaction demo script (owner: Devon, due: 2025-09-29) — script and demo recording link.

Open questions & risks (notes to self):
- Q1: Sable asked whether we can provide an RA-GRS-like geo-redundant backup SLA for model artifacts — we currently offer cross-region replication but SLA needs review (owner: Amelia).
- Q2: They want explicit M-of-N access for master CMKs — confirm supported HSM workflow with security engineering (owner: Ravi).
- Risk: Demo logs contain sampled PII despite redaction flag; need to ensure sample exports are fully scrubbed before sharing.

Regulatory considerations called out by Sable: PCI scope reduction desire, potential need for a pen-test report, SOC2 report request. Action: coordinate with legal & trust to provide appropriate attestations (owner: Amelia).

Communication plan and delivery timeline (high level):
- By 2025-09-22: provide KMS design (A3), RBAC matrix draft (A7), and logging config example (A5) — for initial review.
- By 2025-09-30: populate runbook (A2), KV-cache policy (A11), token redaction demo (A12).
- By 2025-10-05: provide HSM signing artifacts (A4), monthly vuln scan (A9) if available, finalize evidence bundle for customer.

Internal notes for packaging evidence bundle:
- Put PII-redacted artifacts into s3://redwood-evidence/sable-retail/presentable/ with object tagging 'sable-poc:presentable'.
- Provide a signed manifest (SHA256) for every artifact we share.
- Keep a separate secure access path for full (non-redacted) artifacts; share key material only under an executed DPA and designated access approval.

Draft responses to Sable questionnaire (snippets):
- "How is customer data isolated?" — "For Dedicated deployments we provision compute inside the customer VPC or via VPC peering. Control plane access is restricted and all data at rest is encrypted with customer-managed keys where requested. Please refer to artifact A1 (network diagram) and A3 (KMS integration)."
- "How long do you retain logs?" — "Retention configurable; default pilot retention is 90 days. We can extend to 1 year for audit-only retention. See A6 for a sample syslog export."

Attachments to prepare for external delivery:
- Condensed evidence packet PDF (redacted) for Sable security review.
- Step-by-step demo recording (30 mins) showing redaction + KV-cache behavior.
- Checklist for Sable to validate items on their side (network ACLs, Okta test account, storage access).

Notes to reviewers: this is a living document. Keep changes trackable and update the evidence index when artifacts are uploaded. When marking an artifact as "final" move it to the presentable S3 prefix and add the manifest SHA to the Confluence evidence page.

Changelog (quick):
- 2025-08-12 created initial stub and workshop agenda (Amelia).
- 2025-09-18 added workshop notes and preliminary action items (Amelia, Devon).
- 2025-09-22 added KMS design draft (Amelia).
- 2025-10-02 updated HSM artifact due date and moved status to in_review (Priya).

Unresolved internal TODOs (personal notes):
- Verify M-of-N HSM workflow with SecEng — Ravi.
- Produce redaction demo export and confirm no residual token samples — Devon.
- Generate signed manifest for A2 when runbook finalized — Marisol.

End of doc.
